scope: All 1800 original-six internal videos; identical policy for every class and both frozen splits
fallback: If no technically eligible candidate exists, select the highest-ranked readable integrity-verified candidate; retain every flag. Block only if no technically usable candidate remains or provenance differs.
context: Use entire cached source frame; no ROI crop, mirroring or new extraction
semantics: Unverified video-derived class labels. Semantic review is reported, not a universal gate. No prediction/accuracy-dependent selection.
historical_compatibility: Old ranking plus a hand-visibility preference. All 480 previous selections agree; one previously unselected video changes relative to the old rank.
